spec.title: Node
spec.description: CPU, memory and fullest filesystem of the k3s node.

spec.title: GPU
spec.description: GPU load, memory, temperature and power. Opens 01 - GPU & models.

spec.title: Models
spec.description: Local models served by vLLM: requests running and queued, KV cache use, generation speed.

spec.title: Gateway
spec.description: LiteLLM: requests, failures, latency and spend over 24 h. Opens 02 - AI gateway.

spec.title: Platform
spec.description: Kubernetes: pods not running, containers restarted in the last hour, scrape targets down, fullest volume. Argo CD is not measured yet.

spec.title: Agents
spec.description: Agent teams of the harness: agents working, waiting, idle, down, and the team cost today. Opens the Agent harness dashboard.
